title: Kids' Product Recalls: CPSC, NHTSA and FDA
subtitle: Weekly child-product recall records with hazards, remedies and official links
description: A normalized weekly dataset of U.S. federal recalls for products made for or primarily used by children. Records come from CPSC, NHTSA and FDA sources and include the announcement date, product category, hazard, consumer remedy and official notice URL. The canonical live tracker is https://www.kindlykiddo.com/kids-product-recalls/ and the public source repository is https://github.com/kindlykiddo/kids-product-recalls.

userSpecifiedSources: [CPSC recalls](https://www.cpsc.gov/Recalls), [NHTSA recalls](https://www.nhtsa.gov/recalls), and [FDA enforcement reports](https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/scripts/ires/), normalized by [KindlyKiddo](https://www.kindlykiddo.com/kids-product-recalls/).
